name: Integrated Personnel Services Ltd.
summary: Integrated Personnel Services Ltd., also known as IPS Group, is an India-based human resource (HR) consulting and management company publicly listed on the National Stock Exchange of India. The company provides a comprehensive suite of HR solutions, including flexi-staffing, temporary and permanent recruitment, executive search, and international talent placement. Its services extend to payroll outsourcing, regulatory compliance management, vocational training, and assessments. Integrated Personnel Services Ltd. utilizes AI-powered HRMS and workforce automation systems to deliver its offerings. The company primarily serves diverse industries such as Information Technology, BFSI, Manufacturing, Engineering, Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, Energy, Logistics, Retail, Oil & Gas, Hospitality, Infrastructure, and Telecommunication. It operates across India with a significant operational footprint and also handles international placements, particularly in the Middle East and Gulf countries.
